paragraphs: Mar Tavi. Tavi son of Mari Tavi — Rosh Hashanah 22a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading has מר טבי, Mar Tavi; the following phrase has מרי טבי, Mari Tavi. Rosh Hashanah 22a in the William Davidson Edition – Vocalized Aramaic likewise has טָבִי בְּרֵיהּ דְּמָרִי טָבִי. The two forms are not harmonized.
ר״ה כב.. is expanded as Rosh Hashanah 22a, with the doubled period read as an amud marker and terminal stop. “Son of” preserves בריה ד; this notice supplies no further biography.
